New message in #sales:

dave: @lobu who owns the Globex account these days?

input.text: Hey Dave — I don't have access to look up account ownership data, so I can't pull up who owns Globex right now. Someone with access to the CRM (or the sales team) should be able to find that in the account record. If you can give me a tool or integration to query accounts, I'd be happy to help next time!
